title: Shard KPIs
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: the OTel metrics payload/tools/metrics_to_otlp.py exports (this phase's Task 1), read-only aggregates over kind:"task"/kind:"learn" records in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl. Exact instrument names as currently implemented in metrics_to_otlp.py's emit_metrics(): claude_agent_loop.tests (Counter, attribute result=passed|failed), claude_agent_loop.error_rate (Histogram, no attributes), claude_agent_loop.verdict (Counter, attribute verdict), claude_agent_loop.resources_source (Counter, attribute resources_source=workorder|task|session|session-backfill), claude_agent_loop.heuristic_firings (Counter, attribute rule=<literal rule id string>). All five are CUMULATIVE-temporality by design (see metrics_to_otlp.py's module docstring) — each export reports the complete running total, never a per-run delta.

panels.title: Tests passed vs failed
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.tests counter, attribute result. Summed over kind:"task" records' tests sub-object.

targets.query: SELECT result, sum(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_tests GROUP BY result

panels.title: error_rate distribution
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.error_rate histogram. Raw error_rate values across kind:"task" records that carry a numeric error_rate (a missing, null, or non-numeric value is excluded, not coerced to zero).

panels.title: Verdict mix
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.verdict counter, attribute verdict. A missing or explicit-null verdict is bucketed as <missing>, never coerced to the string "unknown" — verdict is not a universal kind:"task" field.

targets.query: SELECT verdict, sum(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_verdict GROUP BY verdict
SELECT resources_source, sum(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_resources_source GROUP BY resources_source

panels.title: Precise-vs-backfill attribution ratio
panels.description: Derived from the same claude_agent_loop.resources_source counter, split per heuristics_eval.py's PRECISE_SOURCES convention: "task"/"workorder" attributions are PRECISE (a specific task, or plan_task.py at assignment time, announced its own resources); "session"/"session-backfill" are COARSE (inherited from the session's ANNOUNCE, not per-task). Ratio = precise / (precise + coarse). Broken out as its own explicit panel per the source spec's callout, since session-backfill is the normal ~98% case in real historical data (subagents rarely announce) and a reader should never mistake a coarse-dominated total for a precise one.

targets.query: SELECT sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resources_source IN ('task','workorder')) * 1.0 / sum(value) AS precise_ratio FROM claude_agent_loop_resources_source

panels.title: Heuristic firings by rule
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.heuristic_firings counter, attribute rule — the literal rule-id string from kind:"learn" records (no hardcoded H1-H8 allowlist; a retired or renumbered id such as H0, confirmed present in real historical data, is still counted rather than dropped).

targets.query: SELECT rule, sum(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_heuristic_firings GROUP BY rule ORDER BY sum(value) DESC
